task_completion.description: Interior partition walls are constructed to create 5 distinct zones (Lobby, GM Control Room, and 3 Game Chambers) with identifying labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a 2D floor plan or 3D view showing internal walls dividing the space into 5 rooms, each containing text labels or room names (Lobby, GM Control Room, Chamber 1, 2, 3).

task_completion.description: Doors are placed connecting the Lobby to Chamber 1 and the GM Control Room, and sequential doors between the three chambers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the floor plan for door icons or 3D models of doors placed in the walls between the specific rooms mentioned in the sequence.

task_completion.description: At least three rooms have distinct floor colors or textures to differentiate game areas from administrative zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Observe the 3D view or room properties to see at least three different floor patterns or colors (e.g., wood in chambers vs. tile in lobby).

task_completion.description: Administrative areas (Lobby/GM Room) contain at least six seating items and two desks or tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count furniture in the Lobby and GM Control Room; look for chairs/sofas (6+) and desks/tables (2+).

task_completion.description: Game Chambers contain at least eight storage or prop items (bookcases, shelves, chests).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count storage-type furniture specifically within the three Game Chambers; look for at least 8 items like wardrobes, shelves, or boxes.

task_completion.description: The facility contains at least 40 total furniture items and at least 4 light fixtures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the furniture list pane (usually on the left) for a high volume of items and look for lamp/light icons in the 3D view or list.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the catalog, dragging items, or using the wall drawing tool within the application window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made complete file but built upon the vacant shell.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the progression from an empty shell to a furnished facility.

integrity.description: The agent attempted to save the project as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save' dialog box or the 'File' menu being accessed at the end of the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with 'escape_room_starter.sh3d', which is a shell with no furniture. Success requires: 5 labeled rooms, specific door routing (Lobby->Chamber 1, Lobby->GM, Chamber 1->2->3), 3+ floor textures, 6+ seats and 2+ tables in admin areas, 8+ storage items in chambers, 4+ lights, and a total furniture count of at least 40 items. The pass threshold is a score of 70/100.
